Class Locomotive

java.lang.Object
domain.Locomotive
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Locomotive extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a locomotive in the railway system. This class stores information about a locomotive's model, fuel type, operational years, costs, and performance characteristics.

    • Locomotive

      public Locomotive(String locomotiveModel, String fuelType, int startYear, int endYear, int price, int maintenanceCost, int fuelCost, int maxSpeed)
      Creates a new Locomotive instance with the specified characteristics.
      Parameters:
      locomotiveModel - The model name of the locomotive
      fuelType - The type of fuel used by the locomotive
      startYear - The year when this locomotive model became available
      endYear - The year when this locomotive model was discontinued (use 99999 for still in production)
      price - The purchase price of the locomotive
      maintenanceCost - The annual maintenance cost
      fuelCost - The cost of fuel per unit
      maxSpeed - The maximum speed the locomotive can achieve
